text: Maakan ɓe an Nulaaɗo: Ko hommbo woni daɗndoowo on e Alla, si O faandanike on ko añuɗon e maayde maa heɓideede, walla si O faandanike on ko jortiɗon e kisal maa moƴƴere? Alaa daɗndoowo on e ɗum. Ɓee naafiqiiɓe non, ɓe heɓantaa ko'e maɓɓe, gaanin Alla, giɗo heftoowo fii maɓɓe, wanaa ballo daɗndoowo ɓe e lepte Alla ɗen.
